infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Companion records short video evidence only after an emergency when you explicitly enable evidence recording.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Companion shares your live location with trusted contacts during a safety journey.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Companion keeps your journey location updated when your phone is locked during an active safety session.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Companion listens for your chosen SOS phrase and distress sounds during an active safety journey.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Companion shares your live location with trusted contacts during a safety journey.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Companion keeps your journey location updated while your phone is locked.

plugins.microphonePermission: Companion listens for your chosen SOS phrase during an active safety journey and records audio only after an SOS when you opt in.

plugins.cameraPermission: Companion records short video evidence only after an emergency when you explicitly enable evidence recording.
plugins.microphonePermission: Companion records audio with emergency video evidence only after an emergency when you explicitly enable evidence recording.

plugins.motionPermission: Companion checks movement for possible falls during an active safety journey.
